finance.title: Finance
finance.description: Expenses, cash, taxes and partners: the real margin and how long the cash will last.

kpi.label: Finance figures
kpi.cashNone: Add an account and its balance to see cash, runway and the forecast.
kpi.cashNoBalance: No account has a recorded balance yet.
kpi.cashMixedDates: Some balances date from {from}: update them for a more accurate figure.
kpi.fixedHistory: Fixed costs: {amount}/month (average of {months, plural, one {# closed month} other {# closed months}})
kpi.fixedSubscriptions: Fixed costs: {amount}/month, based on fixed subscriptions
kpi.runwayHint: Months of fixed costs that today's cash covers, with no further income.
kpi.burnNone: Record expenses to see how much is spent each month.
kpi.burnWindow: Average of {count, plural, one {# closed month} other {# closed months}} · revenue {revenue}/month
kpi.marginNoExpenses: That month has no recorded expenses: the margin doesn't include them.

pnl.title: Revenue, expenses and margin
pnl.description: Last 12 months. Revenue: the base of what's invoiced. Expenses: what they cost (base plus non-deductible VAT).
pnl.empty: No revenue or expenses to show yet.
pnl.noExpensesNote: * Months without any recorded expenses: their margin only reflects revenue.
pnl.tableCaption: Revenue, expenses, fixed expenses and margin for each month

forecast.title: Cash forecast · {days} days
forecast.description: Today's cash + outstanding and expected payments (incl. VAT) − expenses and charges − VAT and withholdings when due.
forecast.negative: Cash goes negative on {date}: it reaches {amount}.
forecast.noFlows: No movements expected on this day.
forecast.more: and {count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}
forecast.tableCaption: Expected movements with their date and the balance after each one
forecast.footnote: Based on today's data: it doesn't include sales or expenses that don't exist yet. Overdue invoices count as collected today. Taxes are estimates.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: The last recorded balance of each account.
accounts.asOf: {date} · {days, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}}

upcoming.title: Upcoming payments
upcoming.description: What goes out of the cash in the next {days} days.
upcoming.empty: Nothing to pay in the next {days} days.
upcoming.footer: {count, plural, one {# payment} other {# payments}} · {amount} in total
upcoming.footerEmpty: Pending expenses, subscriptions and taxes appear here.

taxes.title: VAT and withholdings
taxes.description: What will have to be paid to the tax agency each quarter, by issuer.
taxes.estimateNote: An estimate for cash planning: check with your accountant before filing anything.
taxes.withholdingsHint: Withheld from professionals and on rent (111/115)
taxes.forecastIncluded: Includes {amount} of forecast VAT for the rest of the quarter.

expenses.readOnly: You have read-only access: you can see expenses, not change them.

summary.totalHint: {count, plural, one {# expense} other {# expenses}} · base {base} · VAT {vat}
summary.pendingHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing pending} one {# pending expense} other {# pending expenses}}
summary.overdueHint: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing overdue} one {# overdue expense} other {# overdue expenses}}

expenses.noResultsBody: Try another month, category or search.
expenses.truncated: Showing the {count} most recent: filter by month to see the rest.
expenses.keyboardHint: <kbd>J</kbd> <kbd>K</kbd> to move · <kbd>Enter</kbd> to open · <kbd>C</kbd> for a new expense
expenses.emptyBody: Record what you pay (software, freelancers, your accountant, partner compensation…) to see the real margin and cash. Anything recurring is better set up as a subscription.
expenses.rebillFilterHint: Client expenses marked to rebill that aren't on any invoice yet

expenseSheet.description: A supplier invoice, a payslip or a payment to a partner. VAT and withholding are calculated on the base.
expenseSheet.createdToast: Expense recorded: you can now attach the receipt
expenseSheet.deleteBody: The expense and its receipt are deleted. This can't be undone.
expenseSheet.lockedHint: It's generated by an active subscription: correct its amount or turn off the subscription first.
expenseSheet.generatedNote: Generated by a subscription (charge on {date}). Correct it with the real invoice if anything changes.
expenseSheet.baseHint: Excl. VAT. Negative if it's a credit note.
expenseSheet.irpfHint: The one you withhold when paying a professional or rent.
expenseSheet.deductibleHint: If it isn't, the VAT counts as a cost and isn't deducted in the return.
expenseSheet.irpfNote: The {amount} withheld is paid to the tax agency with the quarter's return.
expenseSheet.issuerHint: The SL or the self-employed partner: each one files their own VAT.
expenseSheet.memberHint: If it's their compensation or you're reimbursing something they paid upfront.
expenseSheet.paidHint: If not, it stays pending and falls due on its date.
expenseSheet.attachAfter: The receipt (PDF or photo) is attached after recording the expense.
expenseSheet.rebilledDeleteHint: It's on a client invoice: remove its line first to delete it.

attachment.hint: PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP up to 8 MB. Stored privately.
attachment.tooLarge: The file is larger than 8 MB.
attachment.type: Only PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP.
attachment.uploadFailed: The receipt couldn't be uploaded. Please try again.

subscriptions.readOnly: You have read-only access: you can see subscriptions, not change them.
subscriptions.monthlyHint: {count, plural, =0 {No active subscriptions} one {# active subscription} other {# active subscriptions}} (yearly ones, /12)
subscriptions.next30Hint: What will be charged, incl. VAT
subscriptions.generateHint: The daily run generates the expense for each charge on its day; this does it now for anything missing up to today.
subscriptions.generated: {count, plural, one {# expense generated} other {# expenses generated}}
subscriptions.nothingToGenerate: There were no charges left to generate
subscriptions.onGenerated: Subscription turned on: {count, plural, one {# expense generated} other {# expenses generated}}
subscriptions.offToast: Subscription turned off: it stops generating expenses
subscriptions.emptyBody: Software, rent, your accountant, partner compensation… Whatever is paid every month or every year generates its expense automatically on the charge date.
subscriptions.generatedCount: {count, plural, =0 {no expenses yet} one {# expense generated} other {# expenses generated}}
subscriptions.footnote: With a card or direct debit, the expense is created as paid on the charge date; with a bank transfer, as pending.

subscriptionSheet.description: A recurring expense. It generates an expense on each charge, on the same schedule as billing.
subscriptionSheet.savedGenerated: Saved: {count, plural, one {# expense generated} other {# expenses generated}} up to today
subscriptionSheet.deletedToast: Subscription deleted{count, plural, =0 {} one { with # expense} other { with # expenses}}
subscriptionSheet.deleteBody: The subscription is deleted. This can't be undone.
subscriptionSheet.deleteWithExpenses: The subscription and its {count, plural, one {# generated expense} other {# generated expenses}} are deleted, along with their receipts. If you only want to stop paying it, give it an end date.
subscriptionSheet.memberHint: For a partner's compensation: each generated expense is recorded in their name.
subscriptionSheet.scheduleLocked: It has already generated {count, plural, one {# expense} other {# expenses}}: to change the schedule, give it an end date and create another one.
subscriptionSheet.startsOnHint: Expenses are generated from here. If you already have the earlier ones, enter the next charge.
subscriptionSheet.billingDayHint: From 1 to 31. In shorter months, the last day.
subscriptionSheet.endsOnHint: Last day of service: there won't be any charges after it.
subscriptionSheet.methodHint: Card or direct debit: the expense is created as paid.
subscriptionSheet.activeHint: When off, it generates nothing; turning it back on generates any missing charges.
subscriptionSheet.generationNote: Saving generates the charges already due up to today; after that, the daily run does it.

cash.readOnly: You have read-only access: you can see cash, not change it.
cash.totalHint: {count, plural, =0 {No active accounts} one {Sum of the last balance of # account} other {Sum of the last balance of # accounts}}
cash.emptyBody: Add the accounts of the SL and the self-employed partners and record their balance from time to time (month-end is enough). That gives you cash, runway and the forecast.
cash.footnote: A balance is the one at the close of its day. Today's cash adds what's been collected and paid since each issuer's last balance.
cash.balanceDescription: An account's balance at the close of a day. If there was already one for that day, it's replaced.
cash.balanceOnHint: The balance at the close of that day.
cash.accountDescription: A bank account of the SL or of a self-employed partner.
cash.accountIssuerHint: The issuer it belongs to: it counts towards that issuer's cash.
cash.accountActiveHint: When closed, it no longer counts towards cash; its history is kept.

partners.readOnly: Only an owner can change the shareholdings.
partners.sharesDescription: What share of the SL each partner holds from each date. Each split adds up to 100%.
partners.noCurrent: No split is current yet: the first one starts later.
partners.sheetDescription: Each partner's shareholding from a given date. They must add up to 100%.
partners.validFromHint: Current from this day until the next split.
partners.compensationDescription: What their compensation costs each month (expenses in the “Partner compensation” group).
partners.compensationEmpty: No compensation recorded yet. A subscription with the partner assigned generates it every month.
partners.compensationNote: Cost: the base (plus VAT if it isn't deductible). The withholding applied doesn't reduce it: it's paid to the tax agency.

settings.title: Expense categories
settings.description: What each expense is for. The group organizes the margin, and “fixed” decides what the runway covers.
settings.expensesCount: {count, plural, =0 {No expenses} one {# expense} other {# expenses}}
settings.lastOne: There must be at least one category.
settings.archivedDescription: They can no longer be chosen; expenses that have them keep them.
settings.archiveBody: It will no longer appear when recording expenses. Expenses that already have it don't change.
settings.formDescription: An expense category for the organization.
settings.name: Name
settings.isFixedHint: Paid even if nothing is sold (rent, software, accountant, salaries). It's what the runway covers.
settings.groupsDescription: Each category belongs to one. The reports and the CFO agent read the margin by group.

groupHints.operating: What it costs to operate: software, office, accountant, insurance, your own advertising…
groupHints.payroll: The team's payroll and Social Security.
groupHints.partner_compensation: What the partners are paid for their work (payroll or as self-employed company partners) and their contributions.
groupHints.cost_of_sales: The direct cost of what's sold: freelancers, purchases for clients…
groupHints.taxes: IAE, fees, corporate tax… VAT and withholdings are settled separately: they're not expenses.
groupHints.other: Anything that doesn't fit anywhere else.

settings.listChanged: The list changed while you were editing it. Reload the page.
settings.notFound: That category no longer exists or has been archived. Reload the page.
settings.inUse: It's used by {count, plural, one {# active subscription} other {# active subscriptions}}: change their category or turn them off first.

validation.money: Invalid amount. Use, for example, 1500 or 49.99.
validation.percent: A percentage from 0 to 100, e.g. 21 or 15.5
validation.dueBeforeIssue: It can't be due before the invoice date
validation.endBeforeStart: It can't end before the first charge
validation.sharesTotal: The shareholdings must add up to 100%
validation.clientNotAllowed: Only a client's expense has a client
validation.rebillClientOnly: Only a client's expense can be rebilled
validation.markup: A markup from 0 to 1,000%, e.g. 10 or 12.5

errors.expenseNotFound: That expense no longer exists or you don't have access to it. Reload the page.
errors.subscriptionNotFound: That subscription no longer exists or you don't have access to it. Reload the page.
errors.accountNotFound: That account no longer exists or you don't have access to it. Reload the page.
errors.balanceNotFound: That balance no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.balanceFuture: A balance can't be for a day that hasn't come yet.
errors.categoryArchived: That category is archived: choose another one.
errors.categoryDuplicate: There's already a category with that name.
errors.expenseGenerated: This expense is generated by an active subscription: correct its amount or turn off the subscription first.
errors.subscriptionScheduleLocked: This subscription has already generated expenses: to change its schedule, give it an end date and create another one.
errors.subscriptionHasExpenses: This subscription has already generated expenses: delete it together with them or give it an end date.
errors.shareholdingsTotal: The shareholdings for a date must add up to 100%.
errors.vendorDuplicateTaxId: There's already another supplier with that NIF.
errors.ibanDuplicate: There's already another account with that IBAN.
errors.balanceDuplicate: That account already has a balance for that day.
errors.externalIdDuplicate: That transaction had already been imported.
errors.reference: Something you selected no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.amountsInvalid: The amounts don't add up. Check the base, VAT and withholding.
errors.vendorNotFound: That supplier no longer exists or you don't have access to it. Reload the page.
errors.expenseRebilled: This expense is already on a client invoice: remove its line from the invoice first.
errors.rebillTaken: Some expense had already been rebilled. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rebillEmpty: There are no expenses to rebill.
errors.rebillDraftInvalid: That draft no longer belongs to the client or has been issued. Reload the page.

vendors.title: Suppliers
vendors.description: They're created when an expense is recorded; here you complete the NIF and country (for your accountant and for imports) and the category suggested for their expenses.
vendors.empty: No suppliers yet: they're created when the first expense is recorded.

vendors.archivedToast: “{name}” archived: it's no longer suggested for expenses
vendors.formDescription: Whoever invoices you: a company, a professional or a public body.
vendors.name: Name or legal name
vendors.taxIdHint: The one on the invoice, without spaces or hyphens.
vendors.categoryHint: Suggested when recording one of their expenses.
